name: CENNETIC M6 High-Rigidity Vertical Machining Center
summary: The M6 is a high-rigidity vertical machining center for mold and general parts machining, built for stable finishing and heavy cuts.
body:
The M6 is a high-rigidity vertical machining center for mold and general parts machining, built for stable finishing and heavy cuts.

Equipment

Standard equipment

  • Bed — Cast Iron — Resin-sand casting (HT300)
  • Bed — Lubrication Circuit — Automatic (Auto lubrication)
  • Bed — Ball Screw — HIWIN (Taiwan)Ball Screw/THK (Ball screw4010)
  • Bed — Linear Guideway — HIWIN (Taiwan)/THKLinear guideway (XY: RG45(roller)/Z:55)
  • Appearance — Sheet-metal Enclosure — Full enclosure (Ivory + dark grey)
  • Lubrication — Electric oiler — RGB electric oiler (Electric oiler)
  • Lighting — Linear work lamp
  • Accessories — Tool holders / collets — BT40-ER32 (10 pcs each)
  • Accessories — Tool kit (1 set)
  • Accessories — Tool-holder stand (1 pcs)
  • Accessories — Manual (1 set)
  • Service — Freight — in/out province (in/out province)
  • Service — Training — on-site (On-site)
  • Service — Warranty — 1 year (1 yr)

Optional equipment

  • Bed — Spindle — DANQUAN (Taiwan) (OD150mm/BT40-8000 rpm)
  • Electrical — Feed-motor type — FANUC/Mitsubishi/Syntec (5.9 kW/28.4 N·m(SyntecAM28))
  • Electrical — Spindle — FANUC/Mitsubishi/Syntec (11-15 kW/69.4/94.6)
  • System — CNC: FANUC / Mitsubishi / Syntec (0i-MF5 Plus/M80/22MA)
  • Tool Change — Pneumatic tool changer — OKADA (Taiwan) (Disc-typeBT40-32 tools)

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
